SpaceX has launched the Starlink Group 17-17 mission, aboard the Falcon 9 B1081-23 from SLC-4E at the Vandenberg Space Force Base (VSFB), in California, sending 25 Starlink v2 Mini satellites, into Low Earth Orbit.
Completing its part of the mission, the booster returned back to Earth, landing on "Of Course I Still Love You" (OCISLY), out in the Pacific Ocean.  This marked the 250th consecutive successful landing of a Falcon 9 booster. (March 26, 2026) | NASASpaceflight.com | Facebook
